study type: Retrospective analysis of maternal death review data
cohort: Women who died during the study period (n=80)
finding: The analysis of maternal death reviews in this setting was limited by incomplete documentation, highlighting the need for more comprehensive data collection to improve the quality of maternity care.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery, place of delivery, and delivery assistant were recorded in only 44 (72.1%), 38 (62.3%), and 23 (37.7%) of cases, respectively, indicating incomplete documentation.
gest_age: Recorded in 23.8% of maternal death review forms
